# 0) Configuration

```{r}
out_dir <- here("data_out", "OBISwoaFishBase")

# This is your renamed combined_cell CSV:
tO2_obis_cell_csv <- file.path(out_dir, "binOccurrencesCell__dT_0.50C__dO2_0.50kPa__T_0_30__pO2_0_30.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(tO2_obis_cell_csv))

# Load and glimpse
tO2_obis_cell <- readr::read_csv(tO2_obis_cell_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("group","mass_bin","T_bin","O2_bin","n") %in% names(tO2_obis_cell))) # Expected columns: group, mass_bin, T_bin, O2_bin, n
tO2_obis_cell

# Plot resolution (can be >= stored resolution).
# If you stored 0.5 x 0.5, then:
#   plot_dT = 0.5, plot_dO2 = 0.5 -> no coarsening
#   plot_dT = 1.0, plot_dO2 = 1.0 -> coarsen by 2x
plot_dT  <- 1.0
plot_dO2 <- 1.0

# Axes ranges
T_range  <- c(0, 30)
O2_range <- c(0, 30)

# pO2_act analysis settings
target_group <- "epipelagic"
T_lo <- 5
T_hi <- 15
Q_low <- 0.01    # log10-quantile (try 0.10, 0.05, 0.02)
k_min <- 0       # 10^1 g
k_max <- 6       # 10^6 g
min_total_weight <- 200  # minimum sum(n) per mass bin within T band
```


# 1) Plotting

## a) Helpers

```{r}
# --- Aesthetics (same as before) ---
scale_fill_blue_counts <- function(fill_title = "Occurrences",
                                   na.value = "white",
                                   guide = legend_bar_guide()) {
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#67A5CA", high = "#251A2D",
    trans = "log10",
    name = fill_title,
    na.value = na.value,
    guide = guide
  )
}

# --- Coarsen bins: aggregate counts onto coarser bin centers ---
# Assumes T_bin and O2_bin are already bin CENTERS on a regular grid.
coarsen_PT_bins <- function(df, dT_new = 1.0, dO2_new = 1.0,
                            T_range = c(0,30), O2_range = c(0,30)) {

  df %>%
    mutate(
      # clamp (just in case)
      T_bin  = pmax(pmin(T_bin,  T_range[2]),  T_range[1]),
      O2_bin = pmax(pmin(O2_bin, O2_range[2]), O2_range[1]),

      # map existing centers -> coarser centers
      T_bin2  = floor((T_bin  - T_range[1]) / dT_new)  * dT_new + T_range[1] + dT_new/2,
      O2_bin2 = floor((O2_bin - O2_range[1]) / dO2_new) * dO2_new + O2_range[1] + dO2_new/2
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, mass_bin, T_bin = T_bin2, O2_bin = O2_bin2) %>%
    summarize(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

plot_PT_binned <- function(df_binned,
                           facet = c("grid", "wrap", "none"),
                           title = NULL,
                           T_range = c(0,30), O2_range = c(0,30),
                           theme = theme_surface_default(base_size = 9, square = TRUE)) {

  facet <- match.arg(facet)

  p <- ggplot(df_binned, aes(x = T_bin, y = O2_bin, fill = n)) +
    geom_tile() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = T_range, ylim = O2_range) +
    scale_fill_blue_counts("Cells") +
    labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "pO2 (kPa)") +
    theme

  if (!is.null(title)) p <- p + ggtitle(title)

  if (facet == "grid") {
    p <- p + facet_grid(group ~ mass_bin)
  } else if (facet == "wrap") {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 2)
  }

  p
}

th <- theme_surface_default(base_size = 9, square = TRUE)
```

# 2) Analysis

## a) Helpers

```{r}
parse_k_from_mass_bin <- function(lbl) {
  as.numeric(sub(".*10\\^(-?\\d+).*", "\\1", as.character(lbl)))
}

# Weighted quantile for x with weights w
weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, probs = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  x <- x[ok]; w <- w[ok]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]; w <- w[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  approx(x = cw, y = x, xout = probs, ties = "ordered")$y
}

# pO2_act defined as 10^(Q_q(log10(pO2))) with weights
weighted_log_quantile_po2 <- function(po2, w, q = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(po2) & po2 > 0 & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  10^(weighted_quantile(log10(po2[ok]), w[ok], probs = q))
}
```

## b) Compute

```{r}
df_band <- tO2_obis_cell %>%
  filter(group == target_group) %>%
  mutate(k = parse_k_from_mass_bin(mass_bin)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(k), k >= k_min, k <= k_max) %>%
  # temperature band (using T_bin centers)
  filter(T_bin >= T_lo, T_bin <= T_hi) %>%
  filter(is.finite(O2_bin), is.finite(n), n > 0)

po2_act_tbl <- df_band %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarize(
    mass_center_g = 10^k,
    total_weight = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    po2_act_kPa = weighted_log_quantile_po2(O2_bin, n, q = Q_low),
    po2_med_kPa = weighted_log_quantile_po2(O2_bin, n, q = 0.50),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_weight >= min_total_weight, is.finite(po2_act_kPa))

po2_act_tbl
```

## c) Plot

```{r}
plot_df <- po2_act_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    log10_m = log10(mass_center_g),
    log10_tau = log10(po2_act_kPa)
  )

fit <- lm(log10_tau ~ log10_m, data = plot_df)
summary(fit)

a <- unname(coef(fit)[1])
b <- unname(coef(fit)[2])
r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log10_m, y = log10_tau)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color="black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "log10(mass center, g)",
    y = paste0("log10(pO2_act, kPa) [weighted log-quantile q=", Q_low, "]"),
    title = paste0("Epipelagic pO2_act mass scaling (T ", T_lo, "–", T_hi, "°C)"),
    subtitle = paste0("a=", signif(a,3), ",  b=", signif(b,3), ",  R²=", signif(r2,3),
                      "  (min total weight per bin = ", min_total_weight, ")")
  ) +
  th

ggplot(po2_act_tbl, aes(x = mass_center_g, y = po2_act_kPa)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, color="#6a51a3") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color="#6a51a3") +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color="black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_x_log10(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,30), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Mass bin center (g)",
    y = paste0("pO2_act (kPa) [weighted 10^(Q_q(log10 pO2)), q=", Q_low, "]"),
    title = paste0("Epipelagic pO2_act vs mass (T ", T_lo, "–", T_hi, "°C)")
  ) +
  th
```

ggplot(po2_act_tbl, aes(x = mass_center_g, y = total_weight)) +
